questions.question: What is the offence under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita's section 74, one of those listed where the information must be recorded by a woman police officer, and what punishment does it carry?
questions.must_contain: assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty

questions.question: What is the punishment for the offence under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita provision that this section lists as a ground for declaring copies forfeited, specifically the one numbered 292?
questions.must_contain: fine which may extend to one thousand rupees

questions.question: What does the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 304, which section 283 lists among the thefts triable summarily, say about the maximum imprisonment for committing that offence?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years

questions.question: What is the maximum punishment for the offence under section 220 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 that a person who refuses without reasonable cause to attend and witness a search is deemed to have committed?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one month

questions.question: What is the offence under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 213, cited in this provision on contempt committed in the view of a Court, and what punishment does it carry?
questions.must_contain: refuses to bind himself by an oath or affirmation to state the truth

questions.question: What conduct is punishable under the section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 that sub-section (2) says only the woman's husband is deemed aggrieved by?
questions.must_contain: goes through the ceremony of being married, knowing that he is not thereby lawfully married

questions.question: What punishment does section 67 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, which is cited for the woman-officer recording requirement, prescribe for the offence it covers?
questions.must_contain: shall not be less than two years but which may extend to seven years

questions.question: What offence does the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 73, listed among the offences for which a woman's statement must be recorded by a woman officer, define, and what punishment applies?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years

questions.question: What does section 349 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, which section 283 cites for criminal intimidation, actually provide as the maximum punishment?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year

questions.question: In the charge for voluntarily causing grievous hurt under section 117(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, what is the maximum imprisonment the offender can receive?
questions.must_contain: a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine

questions.question: What penalty does the Sanhita provision cited in the murder charge under sections 103 and 105 prescribe for committing murder?
questions.must_contain: punished with death or imprisonment for life

questions.question: What punishment does the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section that the illustration cites alongside section 98 prescribe for the offence it defines?
questions.must_contain: not be less than seven years but which may extend to fourteen years

questions.question: What does section 16 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, which the charge cites, actually provide?
questions.must_contain: Nothing which is done in pursuance of, or which is warranted by the judgment or order of, a Court

questions.question: What punishment applies to someone convicted under section 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, whose food, drink, drug or medical preparation the Court may order destroyed?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months

questions.question: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 69 that sub-section (4) applies to imprisonment in default of compensation, what is the maximum term of imprisonment for the offence it describes?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years

questions.question: In the illustration where A commits house-breaking by day with intent to commit adultery, what does the cited section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita say is required for a person to be said to commit house-breaking?
questions.must_contain: commits house-trespass if he effects his entrance into the house or any part of it in any of the six ways hereinafter described

questions.question: What punishment does the penalty section cited in section 155 prescribe for a person who fails to comply with the order?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months

questions.question: In the illustration where A rescues B from lawful custody and causes grievous hurt to the constable, what is the punishment under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 119 for voluntarily causing grievous hurt for the stated purposes?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years

questions.question: What punishment does the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita section 188, mentioned in the provision on compounding abetment and attempts, prescribe for the offence it covers?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years

questions.question: What punishment does the section cited in the charge for knowingly delivering a counterfeit coin as genuine provide?
questions.must_contain: imprisonment for life, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years

questions.question: Which kinds of hurt count as grievous under the section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, that A is charged under for voluntarily causing grievous hurt with an instrument for shooting?
questions.must_contain: Permanent disfiguration of the head or face;
